versions.changelog:
youtube-instant-article 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for transforming YouTube videos into Telegraph Instant View articles with slides and timestamped summaries.
- Automatically detects and processes all YouTube video requests (youtube.com or youtu.be URLs).
- Generates visually rich articles: includes video link, interleaved slides, timestamped summaries, notable quotes, and proper YouTube title.
- Uses OpenAI GPT-5.2 for fast, high-quality summaries and automatic timestamp extraction.
- Handles image hosting via catbox.moe and publishes articles directly to Telegraph.
- Requires zsh, summarize v0.10.0+, jq, and proper API keys (Telegraph and OpenAI).
